brief.name: Moth and Matchbox
brief.pitch: Guide a small moth through dark rooms by lighting matches and solving shadow puzzles in a quiet, hand-inked noir story.
mechanics: Light matches to reveal and illuminate dark rooms
Solve shadow puzzles using the match's single warm light
Guide a small moth through each room toward the next chapter
Five chapters structured as a narrative progression
brief.art_style: Hand-inked noir with a single warm light source
facts: The game is a fictional narrative puzzle project created for a portfolio demo.
The game is sold as a one-time purchase at a fixed price, which is yet to be confirmed.
Core mechanics are lighting matches and solving shadow puzzles while guiding a small moth through dark rooms.
The art style is hand-inked noir with a single warm light.
The palette uses charcoal #1A1A1D, ember #FF8F2B, ash #CFCFD4, and ivory #FFF8EA.
The target audience is narrative game fans.
not_true: The game has no jump scares.
The price is not yet confirmed, so no final price should be stated.
The game has no real-money rewards.
The game is not a subscription service.
The game does not reference or depict real brands.
brief.launch_goal: Gather wishlists and installs from narrative game fans.
